description: Recorded drift of the immo zone ids absent from geo's served set, measured on the backups of D. Owner decision 2026-09-26: join-verify is a FIDELITY control of the restore. An id listed here is known-drift (counted, never fails); an id absent from here fails; an id listed here that no longer drifts is reported resolved. The data drift itself is a separate debt (deploy/ci/bascule-2tenants/README.md, 'Join-verify baseline').

causes.referential-version: geo replaced the city's grid or source after immo pulled its zone_versions mirror (immo ogc-pull never closes obsolete versions)
causes.data-gap: isolated codes edited or removed in geo since immo's pull, the rest of the grid unchanged
causes.slug-variant: immo city_slug is not the shared registry slug (municipalities.qc.json, identical in both repos)
causes.geo-no-zone-code: the geo collection is served but has no zone_code property, so geo's served-ids builder emits no id for the city

purge: Delete an id from its group once join-verify reports it resolved. Never add an id by hand: a new drift is a failure to investigate.
